speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hast thy voice back, Will. I listened for the first speech, to hear if the throat would hold against the drums.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cold is gone, Dick. The gallery gives a man a breath between the trumpets.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You may have your breath. The rest of us tramped five acts of Rome in a cold yard. I am not asking you for a new laugh. We are civil today, and I mean to stay so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are civil. I will not write you a new ending for a play the yard has not seen.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Seventeen days to the twentieth, Will. Thou toldst me I should have three full weeks for Berowne. I have seventeen days, and the part is long.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast the seventeen days, Dick. I will not pretend they are three weeks. The day we set is the twentieth, and it is not this week.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Let the length stand, if the Inns men come to hear it when the day comes. Today was Titus, and Titus is done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John. The Princess wants a gown, you said, when the parts went out. Have you been to the mercer?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tomorrow, before dinner, in Cheapside. I am taking Nick with me after the morning, so the man measures the boy we have.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Measure him at the wrists, John, or the sleeves will be a story by Easter. I am not asking what it costs. You have not been yet.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I have not been yet. I will call you, Will, when the man has named his figure. I will not name one in a yard I have not stood in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Call me here. We have rehearsal at nine, and I am in Fair Em at two.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the Queen's twenty pounds are still at Whitehall, whenever a clerk is minded. That is not news. I only do not like a hope dressed as a coin.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is not had, Dick. We will not spend it before we see it. Edith's eight shillings for the sleeves are the same eight, and they are not this afternoon's business.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They were never my purse. Leave them where January left them.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good. A Monday is long enough without a tailor and a Queen in the same breath. Nine tomorrow, and sweep the straw by the trestles, or someone will meet the yard with his nose.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I will tell the yard-man. Keep your roll, Dick. Tomorrow is the new comedy in the morning, and not in front of a yard.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have the roll. It is heavy, and I am not complaining of the weight until I have missed a line. Are you walking up, Will?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: As far as St Helen's. Before nine I go by Blackfriars. I want to ask Field whether a chronicle might be spared when Lent shuts the doors. I am not taking it tomorrow.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A book. God mend us. Ask him for one that can be carried, and then do not bring it into my plot.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Ask him when the house is dark, Will. Give me the seventeen days without a second labour on the same table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The chronicle waits on Lent. Navarre has the mornings until the twentieth. That is the order.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then keep the order. I will call from Cheapside when I know what the man wants. Not before.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be at the inn. God keep you.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you. Nine tomorrow.
